item.title: PHP Data Structure Serialization: When and How to Convert Arrays/Objects to Strings
item.description:
“PHP Data Structure Serialization: When and How to Convert Arrays/Objects to Strings”

When working with PHP, a fundamental challenge arises when attempting to move complex data structures, such as arrays or objects, outside the confines of a running PHP scriptâ€”for storage in a database, transmission over a network, or exchange with a different language environment like JavaScript. These mediums often only handle primitive types, predominantly strings.

How does one effectively represent an arbitrary PHP structure as a format that can be reliably transported and later reconstructed? This process is termed serialization.

item.title: Python Dictionary Persistence: Save and Load Data Effectively
item.description:
“Python Dictionary Persistence: Save and Load Data Effectively”

When working with Python, persisting data structures like dictionaries to files is a common requirement. This allows you to store data between program runs or share it with other applications. Fortunately, Python offers several built-in modules and external libraries to handle this efficiently. This post delves into various techniques for saving and loading Python dictionaries to and from files, providing practical code snippets for each.

item.title: Python Object Serialization: Pickle, Dill, and Alternatives
item.description:
“Python Object Serialization: Pickle, Dill, and Alternatives”

When working with Python, you often need to store objects to a file or send them over a network. Serialization, also known as pickling in Python, is the process of converting an object into a byte stream that can be stored or transmitted, and later reconstructed.

Python Object Serialization: Pickle, Dill, and Alternatives

Solution 1: The pickle Module

The pickle module is part of Python’s standard library and provides a straightforward way to serialize and deserialize Python object structures. It’s suitable for most common use cases.
